description: Persistent graph memory shared across conversations and agents. Graft is a prompter, not a cache: it hands you notes that may be close to the problem in front of you, and a close note is already a win - it gives you a starting point and reminds you what was decided before. Search it before non-trivial work, and write to it whenever the answer you just produced was not already there. Companion skills: `/recall` (search), `/memoryze` (save), `/learn` (bulk ingest; `/learn docs` for a repository's documentation; `/learn bootstrap` for the unattended cold start of a project), `/memory-audit` (maintenance pass + health check). After `/graft-init` the agent runs the whole lifecycle itself (bootstrap, recall, repair, writeback, bounded maintenance) from one cheap `graft status` call, without asking the user. The daemon auto-starts on the first command.
